evals.prompt: I need to create a project.yaml config for a new Go microservice called 'order-service'. It should have a REST API generated from OpenAPI spec (api.swagger.yml), a Kafka producer that sends order_created and order_updated events with typed messages from JSON Schema, and a sys endpoint for metrics. The git repo is github.com/mycompany/order-service. Please write the complete project.yaml.
evals.expected_output: A valid project.yaml with REST ogen transport, sys template transport, jsonschema section, kafka producer with schema references, and an application that uses all of them. Must follow all validation rules.

assertions.name: has_main_section
assertions.description: Config uses a valid Go identifier for main.name (orderservice or orderService), with logger and registry_type; git repo/module path may retain order-service

assertions.name: has_git_section
assertions.description: Config has git section with repo and module_path

assertions.name: has_ogen_rest
assertions.description: Has REST transport with generator_type: ogen and path to swagger file

assertions.name: has_sys_transport
assertions.description: Has sys transport with generator_type: template and generator_template: sys

assertions.name: has_jsonschema
assertions.description: Has jsonschema section with schemas for typed Kafka messages

assertions.name: has_kafka_producer
assertions.description: Has kafka section with type: producer and events referencing jsonschema

assertions.name: has_application
assertions.description: Has applications section with transport in object format [{name: x}] and kafka reference

assertions.name: transport_object_format
assertions.description: Transport uses object format (- name: x) not string format (- x)

assertions.name: all_entities_used
assertions.description: All defined rest, kafka entities are referenced in applications

evals.prompt: I'm getting error: rest 'api' is not used in any application. Config has rest api + sys, worker notifier, but application only has sys transport and notifier worker.
evals.expected_output: Identifies that 'api' REST transport is not listed in any application's transport array. Fix: add {name: api} to the server application's transport list.

assertions.name: identifies_missing_transport
assertions.description: Correctly identifies that 'api' is not in any application's transport list

assertions.name: provides_fix
assertions.description: Shows the corrected config with api added to application transport

assertions.name: uses_object_format
assertions.description: Fix uses object format [{name: api}] not string format

evals.prompt: Add Telegram bot worker to existing REST API project as separate application/container
evals.expected_output: Updated config with: worker section (telegram template), driver section (telegram driver with correct import/package/obj_name), new bot application with sys transport + worker + driver with params

assertions.name: has_worker_section
assertions.description: Adds worker with generator_type: template, generator_template: telegram

assertions.name: has_driver_section
assertions.description: Adds driver with name, import, package, obj_name for telegram

assertions.name: has_bot_application
assertions.description: Creates separate bot application with sys transport, telegram worker, and telegram driver

assertions.name: driver_import_correct
assertions.description: Driver import uses the project's module_path (github.com/myorg/myapp/pkg/drivers/telegram)

assertions.name: original_preserved
assertions.description: Original server application and REST config are preserved unchanged

assertions.name: driver_params
assertions.description: Bot application's driver has params like WithUpdatePoller()

evals.prompt: Мы обновляем проект с v0.29 до v0.31. После установки нового бинаря make regenerate по-прежнему использует старую версию. В Telegram есть init() с cmdMaps[CmdHelp], а в GOAT init() присваивает testEnvInit. Дай порядок обновления и конкретные замены в коде.
evals.expected_output: Explains recorded generator pin and update-starter (or direct versioned bootstrap for an old Makefile), preserves manifest/custom code, migrates Telegram registration to Worker.customize/AddCommands and GOAT to SetTestEnvInitializer, checks selected Go toolchain and build/lint/tests. Does not claim migrate rewrites source.

assertions.name: version_pin
assertions.description: Uses make update-starter STARTER_VERSION=v0.31.0, or versioned direct bootstrap if target absent

assertions.name: source_migration
assertions.description: Uses Worker.customize/AddCommands and var _ = SetTestEnvInitializer instead of init

assertions.name: preserves_project
assertions.description: Keeps meta.yaml and explicit tools.golang_version unless an upgrade is intended

evals.prompt: В проекте v0.31.0 нет onlineconf.path. Можно ли читать onlineconf.GetBool напрямую? Нужны tasks/enabled с default false и tasks/interval с default 30s, плюс метрика task_errors_total по reason. Покажи карты контрактов и использование.
evals.expected_output: Explains built-in occonf/gate exists even without a service map; declares service keys in one tree and metric CounterVec with reason label/help, links maps from project.yaml, uses typed accessors/collector and relevant gates.

assertions.name: onlineconf_boundary
assertions.description: Explains generated occonf and onlineconf-validate exist without onlineconf.path

assertions.name: contract_shapes
assertions.description: Declares bool/duration keys and a CounterVec metric with labels and help

assertions.name: generated_api
assertions.description: Uses generated accessors and metrics collectors, with error handling and dedicated gates

evals.prompt: Регенерация v0.31 падает: я правил api/rest/external/v1/external.yaml, а ещё появился conflict на файл вне manifest. Как сохранить правки? Контракт по git+ssh://git@github.com/org/contracts.git@main#external.yaml. Хочу SOURCE_REF=feature/basic и HTTP Basic auth.
evals.expected_output: Preserves needed edits at source and restores/removes drifted copy; inspects/moves conflicting file without deleting manifest. Explains @main is an explicit pin not overridden by SOURCE_REF. Basic client requires auth_params header/basic, BasicAuth http/basic scheme, username/password keys.

assertions.name: drift_recovery
assertions.description: Preserves edits at source then restores/removes project copy; retains manifest and inspects collision

assertions.name: explicit_pin
assertions.description: States explicit @main wins over SOURCE_REF; unpinned URI needed for branch override

assertions.name: basic_auth
assertions.description: Uses BasicAuth scheme and header/basic auth_params, requires both credential keys and nonempty username

evals.prompt: Добавь в project.yaml свои генераторы TypeScript для limits.yaml (install/cmd/lint), CI checks для lint и unit-tests, lint overrides из файла, OCI labels version/revision и Grafana annotation Deployments. Не патчи генерируемые Makefile/workflows.
evals.expected_output: Uses generator/contract with generator_name, copy and target, supported template variables; github_ci.checks; tools.lint_config.overrides; declared Docker build args in final stage for label references; Grafana annotations with tags. Explains required validation and source ownership.

assertions.name: declarative_features
assertions.description: Uses generator/contract, github_ci.checks, lint_config.overrides, docker build_args/labels, grafana.annotations

assertions.name: custom_generator_contract
assertions.description: Uses Spec/Target variables and clean relative copy/target paths, links generator_name

assertions.name: preserves_generation
assertions.description: Keeps generated files controlled by project.yaml and validates generation/build/gates
